headline: Preprint reports conditional decay of prompt influence in bounded transformer regimes
summary: A 2026-10-16 arXiv preprint proves a conditional O(P(log t)^(L-1)/t) upper bound on prompt-induced hidden-state offsets for finite-depth pre-LN transformers with full causal softmax attention, bounded logits and non-degenerate pre-norm activations. Experiments on Pythia and Qwen2.5 report faster teacher-forced prompt-offset decay in trained than untrained models and a relay-path mechanism that training suppresses early. On Pythia-160m, a uniform logit boost at s=0.5 lowers measured decay exponents by 0.17–0.25 for +2.6% perplexity; on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, fully French outputs rise from 31% to 94% after 2048 tokens. Small multi-turn tests suggest improved adherence, but samples are limited and boosts can cause instruction echoing. These are author-reported results, not evidence of widespread deployed-model failure or a validated production remedy.
